python3 - <<'PY'
a=[[1,6,6,6,6,6,5,6],[7,3,6,7,3,6,5,6],[6,6,6,6,6,6,5,1],[6,4,6,5,6,6,6,6],[3,4,6,4,7,1,5,6],[6,5,6,3,6,6,6,5],[4,3,6,6,6,6,6,6],[6,4,6,4,6,5,1,1]]
n=len(a)
cw=[[a[n-1-j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
ccw=[[a[j][n-1-i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
r180=[row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
out=[a[i]+cw[i] for i in range(n)]+[ccw[i]+r180[i] for i in range(n)]
print('cw',cw)
print('ccw',ccw)
print('180',r180)
print('OUT')
for row in out: print(row)
PY
